svg.title: Trace a notebook answer to its source
svg.desc: A notebook answers from the sources you select. A citation points back to the passage used. Select. Choose the notes that should count for this question. Ask. Request the answer and a link to its supporting passage. Check. Read the passage. A gap in the selected notes means the answer is still unknown.
